title: Late-Label Fees on Marketplace Orders Replacement-Charge Refunds
content:
**Schedule.** The late-label fee of the Marketplace Orders replacement-charge refund follows how the late original went back: one collected by a carrier pickup pays the late pickup fee of USD 9.99; one sent back by drop-off at a carrier store and first-scanned more than the label validity days of 3 after the deadline pays the late drop-off label fee of USD 5.99, since its prepaid label had expired; one sent back by drop-off within the label validity days of 3 after the deadline pays no late-label fee.

The late-label fee is withheld whatever the reason of the return the replacement was shipped against; it is subtracted, as a fixed amount, from the refundable charge, alongside the deductions worked out on that same refundable charge, and the refund never falls below zero.

## Fee by return method

The return method is the method recorded on the return request; the deadline is the unreturned-replacement deadline.

| Return method | First scan, days after the deadline | Late-label fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| carrier pickup | any | 9.99 |
| UPS drop-off | more than 3 (or no first scan) | 5.99 |
| UPS drop-off | 3 or fewer | 0.00 |

### Hypothetical cases

1. Drop-off first-scanned 3 days after the deadline: no fee. Four days after: USD 5.99.
2. Carrier pickup collected 2 days after the deadline: USD 9.99.
